subject: Demo follow-up: proposed pilot roadmap & evaluation charter — Sundial Tech
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@sundialtech.com>, Tom Bauer <tom.bauer@sundialtech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 15:04:00 +0000
Subject: Demo follow-up: proposed pilot roadmap & evaluation charter — Sundial Tech

Hi Alicia / Tom —

Thanks again for carving out time today. Appreciated the open discussion on the ingestion patterns and redaction requirement for PII. Per our demo, I put together a concise pilot plan and evaluation charter to help you get to a go/no-go decision in 4 weeks. The attached checklist and the eval scenarios doc outline the experiments we recommend and the metrics to watch.

High-level proposal (summary):
- Duration: 4 weeks (2-week data integration + 2-week eval sprint)
- Success criteria:
  - Latency: 95th percentile generation latency <= 450ms for 512-token phrased queries
  - Accuracy: Top-1 intent match >= 86% on provided test set (we'll co-curate)
  - Cost: Token unit cost under $0.003 for streamed responses at average throughput
  - Security: No customer PII persisted outside your VPC when using Private deployment (we can run in your VPC or Dedicated)
- Deliverables: integration checklist, weekly status notes, final eval runbook with pass/fail markers
- Ownership: Redwood (Logan/Marissa) for infra + testing; Sundial (Alicia/Tom) for dataset curation and internal signoffs

What I attached: pilot checklist (redwood-pilot-checklist.xlsx) and a short set of eval scenarios (sundial-eval-scenarios.md). Also included a one-page contract summary (redwood-poc-contract-summary.pdf) that covers limited data processing terms and a proposed pilot SOW (not legal final).

Requested next steps:
1) Can you confirm the internal stakeholders who will be the dataset owners and sign the evaluation success criteria? (We need a technical owner and a business owner.)
2) Do you prefer we run the pilot in your VPC (we provide the private control plane) or in Redwood Dedicated? We can share a quick checklist for both options.
3) Suggested kickoff window: Wed 21 Apr — Fri 23 Apr. Are any of those days blocked for your team?

If helpful I can convert the checklist into a one-click onboarding link for your infra team.

Thanks — look forward to your thoughts.

—
Logan Wright
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0199

Attachments: redwood-pilot-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet), sundial-eval-scenarios.md (text), redwood-poc-contract-summary.pdf (summary)

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@sundialtech.com>

Cc: Tom Bauer <tom.bauer@sundialtech.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 19:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Demo follow-up: proposed pilot roadmap & evaluation charter — Sundial Tech

Logan —

Thanks for the clear recap and materials. Very helpful. A few quick notes from our side:

- Procurement/Legal will need the contract summary; forwarding to Tom (cc'ed). He will review the processing terms and get back with any redlines.
- Security has a short questionnaire that we need filled for any external inference provider. Can Neha or Marissa share a SOC2 snapshot and details on key rotation?
- On owners: I will be the business owner; Tom will coordinate procurement. For the technical lead I need to confirm between two engineers — I should know by EOD tomorrow.

Regarding environment: we prefer running in our VPC because of the strict data residency constraints for the pilot — is that ok? If so, please send the on-prem/VPC checklist.

Kickoff window looks fine; prefer Thu 22 Apr morning (PST).

Alicia
Director of Product | Sundial Tech
alicia.gomez@sundialtech.com

- Thu 22 Apr — Kickoff + infra checklist handoff

- Thu 29 Apr — Final evaluation run, metrics capture + decision brief

Thanks —
